housing: Tewkesbury Borough wraps around Cheltenham and Gloucester, so much of its housing is suburban estates at Bishop's Cleeve, Churchdown, Brockworth and Innsworth, with many new-build developments. Tewkesbury town has a medieval centre of timber-framed buildings, and Winchcombe and the Cotswold villages have listed stone cottages. Private renting is below the national average, but rents rose sharply in the year to July 2026. Low-lying land near the Severn and Avon floods regularly.
checkinTips: Homes near the Severn and Avon in Tewkesbury: check ground floors, skirting boards and walls for damp or flood marks, and note any flood barriers supplied.
Timber-framed buildings in Tewkesbury town centre: photograph beams, uneven floors and any cracks in plaster.
Cotswold stone cottages in Winchcombe: record window reveals, damp patches and the condition of any wood burner.
New-build homes in Bishop's Cleeve and Brockworth: note snagging marks, fences, turf and any management company areas.
Rural homes off the gas grid: record the oil tank or LPG supply, fuel level and boiler service label.
tenantHelp: Private tenants can contact Tewkesbury Borough Council's environmental health housing team about disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions.
